product_metadata.title: JALL Digital Alarm Clock, with Wooden Electronic LED Time Display, 3 Alarm Settings, Weekday/Weekend Mode, Temperature Detect, Wood Made Electric Clocks for Office, Bedroom, Bedside
features: 【Sleek Display for Easy Management】- Keep your schedule on track with a glance. Our alarm clock independently displays the date, day of the week, temperature, three alarms, and AM/PM, giving you all the information you need in one place.

【Three Independent Alarms & 9 mins Snooze】- Say goodbye to generic alarm settings. Our clock allows you to set three independent alarms for daily, workday-only, or weekend-only modes. Plus, snooze for an extra 9 minutes of sweet dreams.
【Adjustable Brightness and Volume】- Personalize your experience with adjustable brightness and alarm volume. You're in control of how you wake up and start your day.
【Easy Operation】- Setting alarms has never been easier. We've optimized the process, so you can set your alarms with ease, even without the manual.

【Stylish Wooden Design for Décor】- More than just an alarm clock, it's a statement piece for your bedroom or living room. Our modern and stylish wooden design adds a touch of elegance to any space. Perfect as a gift for kids or anyone who appreciates style and functionality.
